questions.scenario: A Massachusetts pharmacist has 18 eligible CE hours for the year: 4 live hours and 1 law hour. No exemption or specialized-practice requirement applies. Two additional hours may be completed on separate days.
questions.lead_in: Which two-hour plan completes all three outstanding requirements? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacist has 18 eligible CE hours for the year: 4 live hours and 1 law hour. No exemption or specialized-practice requirement applies. Two additional hours may be completed on separate days.

Which two-hour plan completes all three outstanding requirements? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: One live pharmacy-law hour and one eligible home-study hour.
Two home-study pharmacy-law hours.
Two live clinical hours with no law content.
One home-study law hour, counted once as law and again toward the total.

explanation.core_reasoning: 부족한 것은 total 2시간, live 1시간, law 1시간이다. Live-law 한 시간은 두 범주를 함께 충족하지만 실제 수강시간은 한 시간이다.

choice_analysis.A: Live 1시간으로 5시간, law 1시간으로 2시간, 실제 2시간으로 total 20시간을 채운다.
choice_analysis.B: Total과 law는 충족하지만 live는 4시간에 머문다.
choice_analysis.C: Total과 live는 충족하지만 law는 1시간에 머문다.
choice_analysis.D: 한 시간을 두 번 세어 실제 total을 20으로 만들 수 없고 live도 부족하다.

explanation.learning_boundary: 한 판단을 위한 개별 작성 사례. 기존 원칙을 더 명확한 사례로 연습하며 새로운 법규 96개 또는 최근 기출의 재현이라는 뜻은 아닙니다.

questions.stem:

questions.scenario: A hospital purchaser sees a supplier on FDA's outsourcing-facility list. The supplier advertises every compounded preparation it sells as 'FDA approved because this facility is registered.'
questions.lead_in: Which correction is most accurate? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A hospital purchaser sees a supplier on FDA's outsourcing-facility list. The supplier advertises every compounded preparation it sells as 'FDA approved because this facility is registered.'

Which correction is most accurate? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Each preparation is FDA approved once the facility reports that product.
The facility is registered; individual preparations are not thereby FDA approved.
Only the preparations shipped for office use are automatically approved.
The facility registration operates as a separate ANDA for every formulation.

explanation.core_reasoning: 조건부 exemption, facility registration, cGMP 준수, 개별 product approval을 하나로 합치지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: 제품 보고를 제출하는 것으로 개별 approval을 받은 것이 아니다.
choice_analysis.B: 등록된 outsourcing facility라는 사실과 각 제품의 FDA 승인을 구별한다.
choice_analysis.C: 공급 경로와 approval은 별개로 office-use라는 이유만으로 승인되지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: 시설 등록을 각 formulation의 ANDA로 취급하지 않는다.

questions.scenario: A 503A pharmacy receives a bulk ingredient with a certificate of analysis, but the container states 'research use only' and 'not for human use.' Staff plan to use it in a patient prescription because its assay result is within specification.
questions.lead_in: Which assessment is appropriate? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A 503A pharmacy receives a bulk ingredient with a certificate of analysis, but the container states 'research use only' and 'not for human use.' Staff plan to use it in a patient prescription because its assay result is within specification.

Which assessment is appropriate? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Confirm ingredient eligibility; the assay and COA alone are insufficient.
A shorter BUD changes the ingredient to a human-use grade.
Patient consent substitutes for the ingredient requirements.
The COA permits use if the pharmacist doubles the final quality checks.

explanation.core_reasoning: 정확한 identity·assay를 아는 것만으로 적법한 compounding ingredient의 모든 조건이 충족되지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: 시험 결과·COA의 존재와 원료의 허용된 출처·사용 적격성은 별개이다.
choice_analysis.B: BUD 조정은 원료의 법적 분류·출처를 바꾸지 않는다.
choice_analysis.C: 환자 동의로 적용 원료 요건을 면제할 수 없다.
choice_analysis.D: 추가 QC를 임의로 붙여 허용되지 않은 원료의 적격성을 만들 수 없다.

questions.lead_in: Which documentation gap remains? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A pharmacy has a complete master formulation record for a nonsterile preparation. On a particular day it makes a batch but records neither the actual component lot numbers nor who prepared and checked it. It retains only the master recipe.

Which documentation gap remains? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Keep a record of this preparation's actual components, personnel, and batch.
An unchanged supplier invoice is sufficient for repeated preparations.
A dispensing label substitutes for the component and preparation record.
The MFR becomes the batch record if the same recipe was followed.

explanation.core_reasoning: 일반 recipe와 실제 batch accountability를 구별한다. 결과가 좋아 보이더라도 누가 무엇으로 만들었는지 추적할 수 있어야 한다.

questions.topic: Shorter stability overrides a default BUD ceiling
questions.scenario: An otherwise applicable USP default table would permit a longer BUD, but reliable preparation-specific data show this formulation in its actual container is stable for only 10 days under the intended storage condition.
questions.lead_in: How should the pharmacist use the stability information? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
An otherwise applicable USP default table would permit a longer BUD, but reliable preparation-specific data show this formulation in its actual container is stable for only 10 days under the intended storage condition.

How should the pharmacist use the stability information? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Use the prescription's one-year validity as the preparation's BUD.
Restart the 10 days whenever the preparation is moved to another container.
Use the table maximum because a default overrides formulation-specific data.
Do not assign a BUD beyond the applicable 10-day stability limit.

explanation.core_reasoning: 표에서 가장 긴 숫자를 먼저 선택하지 않는다. 실제 formulation·container·storage와 그 근거를 적용한다.

choice_analysis.A: 처방 사용 가능 기간과 preparation의 사용기한은 다른 개념이다.
choice_analysis.B: 용기 이동이 조제시점의 clock나 안정성을 초기화하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.C: 근거 있는 더 짧은 실제 formulation 제한을 무시할 수 없다.
choice_analysis.D: Default maximum은 더 짧은 chemical·physical stability 제한을 넘길 보증기간이 아니다.

questions.scenario: A pharmacy's documented assessment addresses counting intact hazardous tablets. A new prescription requires crushing those tablets to compound a suspension. No assessment or controls for the crushing operation have been established.
questions.lead_in: What is the appropriate interpretation of the existing assessment? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A pharmacy's documented assessment addresses counting intact hazardous tablets. A new prescription requires crushing those tablets to compound a suspension. No assessment or controls for the crushing operation have been established.

What is the appropriate interpretation of the existing assessment? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: It covers crushing if the same employee performs both tasks.
Evaluate crushing under the applicable compounding and containment requirements.
It covers crushing because the active ingredient has not changed.
It becomes sufficient when the patient signs a handling disclaimer.

explanation.core_reasoning: HD 여부뿐 아니라 실제 작업·포장·조작 수준과 노출 위험에 따라 control을 정한다.

choice_analysis.A: 작업자 동일성은 containment·시설·허가의 조건을 대체하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.B: Intact counting과 crushing은 노출 경로·조제 분류가 달라 기존 AOR를 그대로 확장할 수 없다.
choice_analysis.C: 성분 동일성만으로 dosage form·manipulation에 따른 위험이 같아지지 않는다.
choice_analysis.D: 환자 동의는 취급자·환경 보호 기준의 면제서가 아니다.

questions.scenario: At 10 a.m. Monday, a pharmacist learns that a wrong-strength prescription reached a patient. Immediate patient-protection steps are started. The root-cause investigation will finish Thursday.
questions.lead_in: When must the initial QRE documentation be made under the described Massachusetts rule? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
At 10 a.m. Monday, a pharmacist learns that a wrong-strength prescription reached a patient. Immediate patient-protection steps are started. The root-cause investigation will finish Thursday.

When must the initial QRE documentation be made under the described Massachusetts rule? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Within 7 business days after the patient reports an injury.
By 10 a.m. Tuesday, based on the Monday discovery.
By 10 a.m. Friday, after the Thursday investigation.
At the next scheduled CQI analysis meeting.

explanation.core_reasoning: 환자 보호·초기 사실 기록·조사·외부 보고는 서로 연결되지만 같은 완료 시점이나 기준을 갖지 않는다.

choice_analysis.A: QRE 초기기록을 serious-event 외부 보고 시계와 혼동했다.
choice_analysis.B: 알게 된 시점부터 24시간 이내 초기 기록을 작성하고 후속 사실을 업데이트한다.
choice_analysis.C: 조사 종료를 새로운 초기 기록 시작점으로 삼았다.
choice_analysis.D: 정기 검토 일정이 개별 QRE의 초기기록 기한을 바꾸지 않는다.

questions.topic: Defective compounded preparation does not require proven harm first
questions.scenario: A Massachusetts pharmacy has reasonable grounds to conclude that a compounded preparation already dispensed may be defective. No patient injury has yet been confirmed, and some of the same preparation remains in the pharmacy.
questions.lead_in: Which response is appropriate under the stated defect framework? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A Massachusetts pharmacy has reasonable grounds to conclude that a compounded preparation already dispensed may be defective. No patient injury has yet been confirmed, and some of the same preparation remains in the pharmacy.

Which response is appropriate under the stated defect framework? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Wait for a serious adverse event before taking the product out of use.
Document only a supplier return and omit the patient distribution record.
Initiate recall and quarantine without waiting for confirmed patient harm.
Release the remaining preparation until a repeat test confirms the first concern.

explanation.core_reasoning: Product defect와 clinical adverse event는 서로 다른 trigger이다. Recall·quarantine·defect log·외부 report의 각각의 의무를 확인한다.

choice_analysis.A: 실제 serious harm이 defect recall의 필수 전제는 아니다.
choice_analysis.B: 이미 교부된 preparation의 추적·recall 의무를 단순 supplier return으로 대체하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.C: 결함을 알거나 알 이유가 있으면 환자 위해 확정까지 기다리지 않고 recall·격리 및 독립적인 기록·보고를 검토한다.
choice_analysis.D: 재시험으로 처음 문제를 없는 것으로 취급하며 계속 교부하지 않는다.

questions.topic: Recall action before FDA classification is completed
questions.scenario: A manufacturer sends a valid recall notice for a drug lot in the pharmacy. The notice identifies the affected stock and required actions. FDA's public report still lists the recall as not yet classified.
questions.lead_in: How should the pharmacy interpret the missing Class I, II, or III designation? Select ONE answer.
questions.stem:
A manufacturer sends a valid recall notice for a drug lot in the pharmacy. The notice identifies the affected stock and required actions. FDA's public report still lists the recall as not yet classified.

How should the pharmacy interpret the missing Class I, II, or III designation? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The lack of a class establishes that patients could not have been exposed.
Act on the recall notice without awaiting FDA classification.
The product must be a stock recovery because no class is displayed.
The recall has no effect until FDA assigns Class I.

explanation.core_reasoning: Risk class, 회수 진행 상태, 해당 lot의 보유·교부 여부, 주정부 보고를 별도로 판단한다.

choice_analysis.A: FDA 분류 상태만으로 실제 유통·환자 노출 여부를 추정할 수 없다.
choice_analysis.B: Recall initiation과 FDA risk classification은 다른 시점일 수 있다. Class 미정이 대응 유예를 의미하지 않는다.
choice_analysis.C: Class 미정과 유통 전 stock recovery는 다른 사실이다.
choice_analysis.D: Class I이어야만 recall이 작동하는 것은 아니다.
